# Cully v0.10.2

Patch release: stop the Cully terminal from stealing Warp scroll mode.

- In Warp, mouse tracking is off at startup and only turns on while the advisor drawer is open (`Ctrl+]` / `F6`). Closing the advisor releases the mouse again so Warp scroll mode and the host wheel keep working.
- Other terminals keep click-to-open on the compact panel.
- Docs and the Cully skill describe the Warp keyboard path.

Upgrade: install the v0.10.2 CLI and restart `cully run …` (and the advisor daemon if it was already running). No schema migration.
